field_notes.total_assets_usd: totalAssets(): USDat minted against ALTERNATIVE assets. Since 2026-08-19 (implementation 0x496a…) it excludes primary PYUSDx; its fall to 0 is an accessor scope, not a reserve loss.
field_notes.primary_backing_shortfall_usd: max(totalSupply - totalAssets - PYUSDx held, 0). Null before 2026-10-15 = not computed.
